name: Hollis Wickshut
personality: Keeps a light on for arrivals nobody has authorized.
note: The shutter opens inward. He prefers to be the first to know the light is working.

name: Mira Halfheard
acting: Head tilted with a wry oblique mouth.
personality: Wants the echo to say what it meant the first time.
note: I heard my question return in a better mood. Mira caught it before it could answer.
voice: Dry, with a slight upward inflection.

name: Grom Quietband
acting: One eye up and pursed lips.
personality: Broadcasts at the exact volume of a secret.
note: He continued the weather report after the frequency died. Apparently the dead take a keen interest in drizzle.

name: Wes Staticspool
acting: Eyes down with clenched square teeth.
personality: Keeps stray interference wound in very particular layers.
note: The wire never crossed itself. This cannot be said of the instructions.
call: It bites if you unwind it.

name: Nia Punchline
personality: Makes a record of each missing piece.
note: The strip was full of holes. Nia said the report was complete.

name: Sid Cupwire
acting: Widened eyes and a small O.
personality: Wishes the neighbors would stop sounding so interesting.
note: He found the signal came from his own side of the wall. The cup was already full of it.
call: They know we can hear them.
